_readme: Fund-to-company links from the Handelsregister, read 2026-09-26 off North Data's free 'Erwähnungen' block on each Point Nine vehicle's page (which companies' shareholder lists (Gesellschafterlisten) name the vehicle, and the participations its published annual accounts state). Filing-grade membership evidence for the fund positions (COLLECTION.md s5 Germany: backtrace). Partial by construction: the free block shows recent documents and named participations only. Four entities are on no Point Nine list: acardo group AG and zerolens GmbH (recall candidates), Lindentor 226. V V GmbH (a shelf-company name, identity to resolve), Personio Group SE (read as sale consideration for Back).
